chat.t: Hello. It's me, Elisia. ^^
Just like we discussed earlier, I'll be in your care tomorrow.
Hmm?
Are you busy?
Let me know when you see this message! ^^

o: Yeah, yeah, sure.
You mean the request to introduce you to that Sister, right?
I'm supposed to meet her tomorrow anyway, so let's meet up then.

chat.t: Oh my.
What a relief. ^^
Since I couldn't reach you, I actually just arrived in front of your office.
You didn't reply just because you saw me arrive, did you?

o: No way, hahaha.
Anyway, you must be busy, why did you come all the way here? How did you even know where this place was? Shouldn't you head back soon?

chat.t: Okay, see you tomorrow! ^^

lines.t: One day, while taking care of odd requests in Vermont...
So, what's the request?
Fufu... Fixer, did you know?
There is a mansion where a witch lives in Vermont.
Inside that mansion, there is underwear infused with a 'certain power'—
("The ability to control others just by speaking," huh...)
(There's no way I can pass up on this. That underwear is definitely going to be mine—)
*Creak—!*
The Witch's Mansion (?)
Oh.
...Oh my?
Who might you be?
J-Just a passerby.
Mmm...
Of course, there could be a passerby, but this is my mansion, you know?
Don't you think it's a bit strange for a passerby to be inside someone's home?

Ahem, I took a wrong turn, that's all.
I'll leave right now.
Fufu, even so, I can't just pretend I didn't see you.
Why don't we start by introducing ourselves?
I am Elisia. The owner of this mansion.
Would you tell me who you are and how you ended up here?
No, I didn't want to do this either. I had no choice.
I was given—no, forced into this weird job by a suspicious nun!

I explained the whole situation to Elisia.
(Except for the part about coming to steal her underwear.)
I see...
An item that can control others just by speaking,' fufu...
I'm sorry to say, but there is no item imbued with such a special power here.
See? I knew it.
For a nun to slander a good citizen like you, we truly live in dark times.
Fufu, but more importantly, what that nun said at the end...
She said, "May the grace of Harmonix be with you"?
Yeah, though I don't really know what that means.
Oh my, you don't know Harmonix?
You must be new to Vermont, aren't you?

Exactly.
Anyway, that nun is the bad guy in all this.
Mmm, is that really true?
It feels like you're just blaming everything on her.

Ahem.
N-No, of course not.
Fufu... well, alright.
So, you broke into my mansion on that nun's request?
And the 'ostensible' reason was to steal the item we just talked about... is that right?

That's a bit of a harsh way to put it.
It was more like an unfortunate accident.
I see, fufu...

Those who serve the gods are always the most insidious.
Don't you agree?
Exactly my point!
Well then, now that we've cleared everything up, I'll be on my way.
Wait, there's no need to be in such a rush, is there?
No, no. Having me around will only make things awkward.
Oh, you don't need to worry about that at all.
Meeting like this is a twist of fate, and it would be a shame to just say goodbye...

Fufu, what do you think?
Would you do me a favor this time?
...A favor?

chat.t: Hello, good morning.
I'll be in your care today. ^^
Hmm? Are you busy?
Should I come pick you up?

o: I'm on my way, almost there.

chat.t: I'm right outside your office! ^^

o: W-Wait

chat.t: Did you get home safe? Thanks for your hard work today! ^^

o: So what the hell actually happened?

chat.t: Fufu, it was simpler than I thought.
Those girls from earlier, they're regulars at my place.
Posing as believers to hide their identities? How adorable.

o: I don't really get it.
Why would they do something so pointless?

chat.t: I was curious about that too.
When I asked why, they told me the cutest story.
They sent someone to rob the place when <Bloody Mary> was closed'...
You were trying to steal my underwear, weren't you?
Don't you have anything to say to me? ^^

o: No way.
That nun set me up.
I'm the victim here, seriously.

chat.t: I'll hear your excuses when I get there in a little bit!

o: You're not coming here right now, are you?
Excuse me?
Aw, crap.

lines.t:
With Elisia, who had barged into my office out of nowhere,
I headed to the meeting spot with the suspicious Sister.
Secluded Alley

Fufu, thanks for guiding me.
You saved me a lot of trouble.
Now we just need that nun to show up.
I highly doubt it, but she wouldn't stand us up, right?
I'm telling you the truth.
Mmm, is that really true?
By the way, I heard you also run a bar at that mansion.
Is it okay for you to be hanging around like this instead of getting ready to open?

Oh my.
So you knew about my place?
It's quite famous. <Bloody Mary>, was it?
I heard it's the most prestigious bar in Vermont.

Really?
Fufu, I'm honored.
If you're interested, you should drop by sometime.
Though right now might be difficult. We're closed for a while.
Closed?
Yes, I'm reinforcing the barriers around the mansion.
It's hard to focus when there are people around, so I was planning to be alone for a bit...
I never imagined someone would take advantage of that to launch a surprise attack on the mansion.
Wait, I didn't launch a surprise attack or anything.
The bad one is <bouten>that nun</bouten> who gave me the request.
Fufu, and that's why we're going to meet the girl who requested it.
I want to see who the mastermind is behind her. If it is who I think it is...
...I can't just let it slide.
Hmm... I'm not taking her side, but...
If they really wanted to launch a surprise attack, wouldn't they have done it themselves instead of hiring me?
Fufu, that's probably because those girls can't even get close to the mansion.
You see, they can't hide that unpleasant presence unique to believers.
And I've personally dealt with anyone else who tried to sneak in.
So they probably didn't care whether you got caught or not.
See? I knew that nun was a bad one.
Let's teach her a lesson she'll never forget.
...Uhufu.
In that sense, you are a very interesting existence, you know?
...? Why me all of a sudden?
I mentioned earlier that I was reinforcing the barriers around the mansion, right?
Which means there's no way I wouldn't have noticed you breaking in...

Yet, you were wandering around without a care in the world.
I was truly surprised.
Whoa, "breaking in" is a bit of a stretch.
Let's not get hostile. We're both victims here.
...Fufu, it seems you really aren't one of Harmonix's followers after all.
Yet, you managed to enter the mansion right under my nose...

You truly are fascinating...
Do you have a high resistance to Mana?
Wait, we're on the same side.
If we fight, we're only doing a favor for that Moccamix or whatever!
Hmm, hmmm... in that case...
Would you mind if I check what's inside your body?
Don't worry. I'll make it quick, so there's no need to be scared.
W-Wait! Look, that nun is coming!
...Oh, indeed she is.
Told you so. Just wait here.
...Ahem, ah.
May the grace of Harmonix be with you.
Oh, Fixer...!
I heard you obtained 'that item.'  You are truly amazing!
...But where is it?
Nice to meet you, little Harmonix believer.
Wh-What?! L-Lady Elisia!??
...Hmm?
Elisia... <bouten>"Lady"</bouten>?
...A-Ahem.
...Y-You! You tricked me...?!
I knew I shouldn't have trusted an outsider...!
That's my line, you jerk.
Framing an innocent citizen... call yourself a nun?
...F-Framing? What are you talking about?
Playing dumb now? Your cover's already blown.
B-Blown...!? Wh-What do you mean...!
No, I mean, what do you mean by th-that?!
That's it. You need to be taught a lesson.
...Ugh!
E-Everyone, get out here!
Since it's come to this, we'll do this the hard way!
Fufu, so you did have backup.
You guys look somewhat familiar—
A-Argh! E-Everyone, attack!!
A moment later
Urghhh...
...Mmm.
All bark and no bite.
You pervert, your dirty scheme ends here.
...Fufu.
These kids... they really don't seem to be Harmonix believers after all.
...Huh?
If so, why go through all this trouble...?
...Uhufu. Why don't we ask them directly?
So who the hell are they?
Fufu...
Regulars at my place.

o: Hey Elisia, I heard you're pretty good at counseling.
Give me some counseling too.

chat.t: Oh my, you're always welcome, but...
I never expected to hear such a request from you. ^^

o: Hey, even I want some life advice sometimes.

chat.t: Fufu, is that so? ^^
You wouldn't happen to have lingering regrets, would you?
Like, an item you still haven't given up on?

o: Come on, no way, haha. As if.

chat.t: Fufu, alright. Since you're the one asking.
I'll prepare a very special counseling session just for you. ^^

lines.t: Somewhere in a dark alley in Vermont.
...Ahem, ah.
All hail Lady Elisia.
You terrible human! How could you sell me out like that?! Apologize right now!!
Hey, you should be the one apologizing to me.
What? Underwear that can control people with words?
You just wanted Elisia's underwear and told a filthy lie to get it.
I-It's not a lie!
When you talk to Lady Elisia, you really end up doing exactly as she says!
I bet the other members of Lady Elisia's fan club feel the same way!
Why are there so many damn fan clubs in this town?
But what does any of that have to do with her underwear?
How should I know?! That's why we're trying to find out!
So you're just a pervert who wants her underwear after all.
But is she even wearing underwear?
Well, I've never seen it, so I wouldn't know...
But she's clearly not wearing anything on top.
So shouldn't we check the bottom half to be sure?
If stealing the one she's wearing is too hard, you can just bring me a brand new one.
You really are just a massive pervert who wants her underwear.
Honestly, I'm dying to go myself, but...
They said if I get caught one more time, I'll be banned from <Bloody Mary>...
Sob, you're the only one I can trust! Please!!

And so, under the pretext of getting counseling from Elisia,
I visited <Bloody Mary>.
(Like she said, stealing the one she's wearing is a bit too difficult...)
(I should wait for the right moment and search the mansion.)
Hello? It's a bit late for this, but welcome to <Bloody Mary>. Fufu.
Unfortunately, the bartender is away, so I can't treat you to a nice drink, but...
Elisia sat down beside me, holding a glass.
I've prepared an even more special service instead.
You can look forward to it, fufu.
...Ugh.
Urgh, my head...
...Where did Elisia go?
Alright, now is the time.

chat.t: My, where did you go off to so quickly?
The inside of the mansion is quite complex, so it's easy to get lost...
Let me know when you see this message!

lines.t: Phew...
Alright.
...Oh my?
What were you doing in a place like this?
Oh, I was just looking for the restroom.
Mmm, is that so?
But if you were looking for the restroom,  why were you opening the wardrobe?
I just opened it just in case.
Fufu, there's no way it would be in a place like that, now is there?
Follow me, I'll show you the way.
Oh, right.
First, put the underwear you hid in your pocket back where it belongs!
(What? How did she know?)
It's not underwear, it's just a handkerchief I always carry around.
It didn't really look like a handkerchief, fufu.
If that's the case, could you pull it out and show me?
I can't really do that. But it really is a handkerchief.
Fufu, you're quite stubborn.
Now, shall we put it back where it belongs?
...Huh?
What's going on, my hands are moving on their own?!
No, my underwear!
Fufu, your taste in underwear is certainly unique.
...By the way,  do you have a high resistance to Mana after all?
You seem perfectly fine even though I gave you such a direct order.
...? Y-You... you can actually hypnotize and brainwash people?!
Hypnotic brainwashing...? Mmm...
I suppose you could look at it that way, though I don't particularly like the wording.
Of course, it's not like you can use this power just because you have my underwear, fufu.
To be precise, it is my unique magic, 'Spirit Word'. The ability to control others through words.
(Damn... controlling others with words... I'm so jealous...)
Rest assured, it won't cause any physical harm to your body!
It just makes you pay a little bit more attention to my words.
And as the 'price' for sharing all this with you, my magic becomes even more powerful.
No wonder you kept emphasizing the price...
That's right.  But please think of it as a minimal safety measure for everyone's sake.
Sharing your deepest worries with someone is much harder than you think, you know?
For both the one speaking and the one listening, fufu.
Because in the end, things always drift in unexpected directions.
...Just look at what happened today, for instance.
Besides, I have to keep this mansion safe.
On top of that, I even have to look after the kids from Harmonix...
...Fufu, so you can understand why I'd want to make things a little easier for myself, right?
Honestly, I'm not really sure what you're talking about...
And I didn't expect you to reveal everything like this, either.
Don't think too deeply about it. Sometimes, even I want to open up about my worries.
Just like you did, fufu.
Just one thing.
...Yes?
I'm curious about something.
...Where do you learn that magic?
...Fufu.
You really are fascinating. In both good ways and bad.
...Maybe that's why it's such a shame.
To have to ask you to forget about today as a 'request'.
...What? Wait a minute.
So you explain all about your magic... and then you can just tell me to forget it?
Oh, aren't you sharp.
D-Don't use such a cheap magic trick! That's cheating!
Fufu, my magic isn't that all-powerful.
But the more I understand someone, the more things like this become possible.
Don't you think this is a fair 'price' for the counseling? Fufu.
...So that was the reason you were doing the counseling in the first place?!
You coward! You cheat!
Mmm... those words are a bit unpleasant to hear.
Then at least teach that magic to me and me alone!!
Fufu, please just think of it as the price for the counseling!
Now, shall we forget everything we learned today?
N-No! At least let me remember how your chest felt!
Fufu, you're so dramatic!
Now, shall we head back?
Ugh...
(Did she not use it yet...?)

o: Hey, Elisia.
Didn't I go to get counseling from you last time?

chat.t: Yes, you did.

o: But my memory is really fuzzy.
Can we do it again today?

chat.t: Oh, of course.
It seems you drank so much last time that you forgot.
Take your time and enjoy yourself today! ^^
Fufu.
It has been a truly enjoyable counseling session after such a long time, don't you think?

o: I'm telling you this now, but I could actually move, you know?
I was just pretending I couldn't move.

chat.t: Fufu, is that so?
By the way, I don't remember the last time I had this much fun.

o: I couldn't say it earlier, but don't be too disappointed.

chat.t: Fufu, I see.
Actually, my nerves have been a bit on edge lately...
But after our session today, I feel much better.

o: Are you even listening to me?
Your Spirit Word doesn't work on me.

chat.t: Fufu, really?
Then I'll have to test it again sometime soon!

o: Oh, sounds good.

chat.t: Mmm, maybe this isn't right after all.
I'm the type who saves the best treat for last.
I think it's better to save our fun together for a little while longer.
Fufu. See you next time then! ^^

o: Hey, why? We should finish what we started.
Excuse me?
Hello?

lines.t: Bloody Mary
Elisia seems to firmly believe that I forgot about last time.

By the way, I didn't even get a single drop of alcohol,
but she ripped me off claiming I drank a lot...
I need to teach her a lesson.
Hmm? Did you say something?
Nothing. Just that I'm looking forward to our counseling session today.
Indeed, I'm looking forward to it too.
Now then... what is it that you want to 'consult' about? Fufu.
Well, you see...
Mmm...? What on earth are you—
Ngh...!
...What are you doing?
Elisia, you underestimated me.
...Don't tell me you still remember?
But how? I'm sure I told you to forget...
Fufu, that kind of stuff doesn't work on me.
That's impossible...
Then putting back the underwear back then was just to make me let my guard down...?
(...Wait, now that you mention it, that makes sense?)
...Old news doesn't matter.
...Fufu, indeed.
Just because it didn't work once doesn't mean it won't work now.
Haha, I figured you'd say that, so I came prepared.
...Prepared?
Look at this.
With these earplugs, your Spirit Word won't work on me, right?
...Ear... plugs?
...Fufu, ahaha!
I'm going to feel that chest again right here—
Stop, don't move.
—myself!
...Huh?
Fufu, what's wrong?
Damn, did she hypnotize me again?
(Though it's not like I can't move at all...)
(...Wait, a fun idea just came to me.)
Huh? M-My body won't move.
Oh, fufu...
Didn't you say there was something you wanted to check?
